limitations: Two short repeats, 180 measured seconds per build, below the five-minute per-capture gate. No statistical equivalence test.
Each build has one present interval over 50 ms. Only current has one displayed interval over 50 ms. Low counts do not establish regression or equivalence.
GPU utilization is near 99% and temperature near 83 C on both builds; limitation flags are unavailable, so thermal throttling is not diagnosed.
Same enabled widget seed, with existing hidden/replay/event/device coverage limits. Old/current includes runtime/dependency differences together.
Rare six-second overlay stall and private-memory growth remain separate open findings. Packaged release and driving-session acceptance are not tested.
sourceGameFrameFollowUp.conclusion: No increase in current aggregate app CPU or loss of average presented FPS is observed in these short repeats. The suspected aggregate CPU regression is not reproduced in this workload. Existing presentation cost and the rare overlay stall remain open separately; no widget fix is retained.

reviewAudit.status: Same-session source controls did not reproduce an aggregate CPU/FPS regression. Historical cross-date drift, presentation cost, private growth, limited widget coverage and the rare overlay stall remain distinct findings. Neither canvas variant is retained.
reviewAudit.foregroundScope: iRacing was activated before capture and checked periodically through the UI. These point observations and the absence of other automated UI inputs support the intended foreground protocol; continuous OS foreground state was not recorded.

evidenceExport.regeneration: tools/perf/analyze-game.ts regenerates timelines from the fingerprinted local CSVs; distributions, slow-frame counts, capture windows and provenance are retained here.
